newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to push for 103.30 if 103.15 breaks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to push for 103.30 if 103.15 breaks.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE will have to look to continuation charts for their next target if they manage to pierce the contract high at 103.15, technical analysts said.

"We've already seen them open up a little bit firmer," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "I'd be looking for a move to break above 103.15. After that we'd be looking to 103.28,30 which is congestion resistance on the continuation charts back in March this year."
Bunds were quoted at 103.10 at 0654 GMT, up 11 basis points from Friday's settlement.
Bunds hit a low of 103.30 on March 5. Celaya said beyond there, the contract would head for 103.60, with the high of 103.61 coming in on March 4 on continuation charts.
"After that you'd be looking back into the 104.00 zone which is around the contract highs we saw earlier in February," Celaya said.

Analysts at Deustche Morgan Grenfell were also optimistic on Bunds, noting the contract's retracement on Friday stopped short of the 102.49 level, a 32.1 percent retracement of the rally from July 1. That, combined with the contract's positive close, revives the positive tone, they said.
On the downside, Celaya saw initial support at 103.00
"To get bearish we'd have to start making some inroads back below 103.00, 102.93," he said, noting the high from last Thursday at 102.93. Below there the low at 102.53 would be a stronger buffer.
"We're looking for choppy upticks," he said.
Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell also saw support at 102.93, followed by that retracement at 102.49.
At the short end, December Euromarks were quoted at 96.73, down 0.01 on the day.
